DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (Pseudotumor Cerebri).

The combination of severe morning headaches, positional worsening, visual disturbances, and mild papilledema with only mildly elevated blood pressure strongly suggests increased intracranial pressure. Given your age and potential risk factors like obesity, we need to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes. Please continue to avoid heavy lifting and bending over until we arrange for a Lumbar_Puncture to measure opening pressure and send a CT_Scan of your head to rule out a mass lesion.
